module: Driving Dynamics Suite actuator: variable-damping dampers. It groups damper beams (by name) and, according to a named mode (Comfort, Sport...), applies multiplicative coefficients to their jbeam damping values via `obj:setBoundedBeamDamp`. The mode is chosen with `setParameters({damperMode = "name"})`, typically from a `driveModes` mode of type "controller". Call order: `defaultOrder = 80`.
notes: jbeam keys read by init: `dampBeamNames` (list of jbeam beam names), `modes` (header table: `name`, `beamDampCoef`, `beamDampFastCoef`, `beamDampReboundCoef`, `beamDampReboundFastCoef`, `beamDampVelocitySplitCoef`, all 1 by default), `name`.

The coefficients multiply the base values of `v.data.beams` (beamDamp, beamDampRebound, beamDampFast, beamDampReboundFast, beamDampVelocitySplit): the change is therefore not cumulative from one mode to the next. The same speed threshold value (VelocitySplit) is used for compression and rebound.
No periodic update: neither update nor updateGFX. `controlParameters.isEnabled` is not used. An unknown mode name is logged as an error.
`shutdown` sets isActive to false and removes update/updateGFX (nil) but does not restore the damping.

isActing.desc: false: never modified in this file.

reset.desc: Empty (the damping is not restored to its initial state).

init.desc: Finds the damper beams by name and reads the modes.

registerCMU.desc: Called by the CMU to give it a reference to itself.

setDebugMode.desc: Stores the debug mode (no other effect).

setParameters.desc: Applies a damping mode if `parameters.damperMode` is provided.

parameters.desc: Field: damperMode (name of a mode defined in `modes`).

setConfig.desc: Replaces the parameter table (no effect on the modes).

getConfig.desc: Returns a copy of the parameters.

sendConfigData.desc: Sends the parameters to the CMU in a config debug packet.
